services.name: Sunday Drop-In
services.desc: Laugh while learning practical communication and performance skills in a welcoming weekly improv class for all experience levels. Life doesn’t have a script. We bring our own points of view, interact with the world around us, and respond in the moment. Each Sunday, we explore a different set of soft skills through improv games and exercises designed to help you navigate everyday life with greater awareness, flexibility, and confidence.
